# codex-worker

Delegates a code change from a Claude Code session to an outside Codex CLI worker. Covers sandbox scope, the `codex exec` run, monitoring, follow-ups, review, and a worker inside the pstack Orchestrate playbook. Use when Claude Code is the harness and a code delegate should be a Codex CLI run, or when asked to hand a task to Codex, run `codex exec`, or use Codex as a worker or reviewer. Do not use when the agent itself runs inside Codex.

Ships in the [`codex-worker`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install codex-worker@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
